import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (common combined format):
    IP - - [DD/Mon/YYYY:HH:MM:SS +0000] "METHOD URL HTTP/VERSION" STATUS SIZE "REFERER" "USER_AGENT"

    Returns a dict with keys:
        ip, user, ident, timestamp, method, url, http_version, status, size, referer, user_agent
    """
    # Regex to capture the common nginx combined log format
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)'
        r' - - '
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]'
        r' "(?P<method>\w+)'
        r' (?P<url>[^"]+)'
        r' (?P<http_version>HTTP/\d+\.\d+)"'
        r' (?P<status>\d+)'
        r' (?P<size>\d+)'
        r' "(?P<referer>[^"]*)"'
        r' "(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
    )

    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse nginx log line: {line}")

    return {
